title: Past Perfect
explanation:
**Past Perfect** — «минуле в минулому»: дія відбулася **раніше** за іншу минулу дію.

*When we got to the station, the train **had** already **left**.* — спочатку потяг поїхав, потім ми прийшли.

Часто з *already, just, before, after, by the time, never… before*.

Якщо порядок дій і так зрозумілий (*after, before*), Past Perfect не обов'язковий: *After I finished work, I went home* — нормально.

examples.en: When I arrived, the film had already started.
examples.uk: Коли я прийшов, фільм уже почався.

examples.en: I had never seen the sea before that trip.
examples.uk: До тієї поїздки я ніколи не бачив моря.

examples.en: She was upset because she had lost her phone.
examples.uk: Вона була засмучена, бо загубила телефон.

examples.en: By the time we got home, the kids had fallen asleep.
examples.uk: Поки ми дісталися додому, діти вже заснули.

examples.en: Had you met him before the party?
examples.uk: Ти був знайомий з ним до вечірки?

tip: Порівняй: *When I arrived, she **left*** (пішла, коли я прийшов) vs *When I arrived, she **had left*** (пішла ще до мене).

exercises.prompt: When we got to the cinema, the film ___.
I ___ never ___ snow before I came to Poland.
She was hungry because she ___ breakfast.
By the time the police arrived, the thief ___.
I ___ (forget) my password, so I couldn't log in.
___ you ever ___ (try) Thai food before last night? (2 слова)

exercises.sentence: When I got home, my wife has cooked dinner.
I realised I had leave my keys in the car.

exercises.prompt: Він сказав, що вже бачив цей фільм.
answer: He said he had already seen the film.

exercises.prompt: The bus left. Then I arrived at the stop.
answer: When I arrived at the stop, the bus had left.
When I arrived at the stop, the bus had already left.

exercises.uk: Коли я подзвонив, вона вже пішла.
answer: When I called, she had already left.
When I called, she had left.
She had already left when I called.
